text: Want to know if a girl is into you? Look for these three signs. Number one, she touches you. This is the strongest and most reliable signal. Maybe she taps your arm when you joke, maybe she leans close, maybe she playfully bumps into you. Physical contact is her way of saying she is comfortable and attracted. If there is touch, you are not just some guy. You are in her space in a good way. Number two, she initiates. This is huge in today's world. If she texts you first, asks if you are coming to class, checks where you at, or starts conversation on her own, that's a good sign. Most girls don't chase men they are not interested in. If she is taking the first step, it means she wants your attention. Number three, this is a cluster of signs. These are smaller, but together they paint the picture. She fixes her appearance when you show up, her mood shifts positive around you, she listens closely when you speak, and she laughs at your jokes, even the bad ones. One of these alone could be nothing, but two-three stacked together, that's your green light. Bottom line, if she touches you or initiates with you, and you see a couple of these other signs, stop doubting and start acting.
